name: condemning-evisceration-prepare-1-paid-banish-floating-deals-4-more
notes: Condemning Evisceration (r84E55KBLM, EXALTED/WATER ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 2, printed power 4): "[Class Bonus] Prepare 1. On Champion Hit: If Condemning Evisceration was prepared, you may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard. If you do, deal 4 damage to the hit champion." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Return to the Archive (Floating Memory) is seeded in player 2's graveyard. Player 2 pays Prepare 1, attacks (4 damage), then accepts the optional banish of Return to the Archive: 4 more damage (8 total) and the card moves graveyard -> banishment.

rulesClauses: On Champion Hit: If Condemning Evisceration was prepared, you may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard. If you do, deal 4 damage to the hit champion.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The CardEditor ability row for this card never queued the fixed Prepare cost: no $cardActivatedAbilities['r84E55KBLM:0'] entry existed (or, for the Strike from the Mist stub, it was an empty '(engine)' body), so OnCardActivated() queued no 'Pay Prepare N?' decision and wasPrepared was never YES. Live state dump on HEAD 47028d36 before the fix: after the last reserve payment the decision queue went straight to the attack-target / ally-target choice (no YESNO), preparation counters stayed untouched, and answering YES was rejected as 'Invalid selection' (or silently ignored) -- so the card's 'if prepared' rider was unreachable. Fix: hand-authored $cardActivatedAbilities['r84E55KBLM:0'] (GAQueueFixedPrepare(player, 1, 'r84E55KBLM'): the Prepare cost itself is only offered while the [Class Bonus] is active); the generated onHit (PREPARED intent tag, MZMAYCHOOSE banish, 4 damage) already existed but the tag was never set.
